name: Fisher's Landing Resort
note: Marina resort on Martinez Lake (Colorado River backwater) north of Yuma. Dry camping $10 per person per day (12 and under free), 2 weeks $75 or $150/month for 2 people; first-come first-served, pay at the Camp Rental Office. No hookups or marked pads: campers spread out across open desert above the marina, most parked by a shade tree, with roomy, private spacing. Dump station, drinking water, restrooms, showers and laundry nearby; general store sells firewood. --Claude
